description: Spawns an effect (particle) record via func_1513D524, copies the emitter block to rec+0x110 and counts it in D_800DCE20.
Per-player light-flare update: projects source, tests viewport and z-buffer occlusion, fades intensity, builds the camera-facing quad.
Frees the effect's per-player vertex buffers and moves its node to the retired list (func_1513CA6C).
Frees the effect's per-player vertex buffers, unlinks and frees its node (func_1513CAA0).
Effect destructor: detaches its linked object node, decrements D_800DCE20, calls the type's D_8008A33C handler.
Effect destructor (delete variant): detaches its linked node, decrements D_800DCE20, calls the type's D_8008A384 handler.
For every flagged effect node, reads each player's screen cell value from the D_800BEDE4 grid (0x7FFF when off-grid) into +0x15C.
Copies the effect's position (+0x34..+0x3C) into its linked object node (+0x154) when it has one.
Random flicker: on timer expiry picks a new random target scale, then eases the effect scale (+0x158) toward it.
Sine pulse: sets the effect scale (+0x158) to base + amp*sin(phase) and advances the phase by the frame time.
Piecewise envelope pulse (hold, ramp up, hold, ramp down) of the effect scale +0x158, looping with the period.
Effect message handler: forwards to the type handler D_8008A3CC, then 0x22 frees, 0x24/0x25 set state +0x169 to -1/2.
Broadcasts message code arg1 with id byte arg0 to the node types 0x1C and 0x56 (func_15169260).
Stub callback that always returns 0.
Places the effect on a rotated offset around a centre point (rotation matrix) and sets its axis point 500 units outward.
Per-frame update calling effect_set_orbit_pos with the parameters stored at +0x170.
Calls the per-frame hook (+0x18) of every one of the 101 node type records in D_8008B848 that has one.
Calls each of the 3 global hook functions in D_8008CF04 that is set.
For both node rows and all 101 types with an update handler (field 0), calls it on every node (unlink-safe walk).
For both node rows and all 101 types with a second handler (field +4), calls it on every node (unlink-safe walk).
Caches sin/cos of each player's camera yaw, then calls each type's +0x0C handler on every node.
Draws the render layers of a group: per layer pre DL/callback, each node's draw callback, post DL/callback, with DL overflow cut.
Allocates a node of given size, sets its row and owner byte (+0xC) and links it into the list of type arg0.
Allocates a type 3 node and copies 0x18 bytes of sprite quad data to +0x10, alpha 0xFF.
Type 3 node update: runs its callback, fades alpha, advances the animation frame and frees the node at the end.
Render-layer 3 draw callback: draws the node's textured screen quad.
Allocates a sprite node (type 5, or 0x42 when arg1 set) and copies 0x38 bytes of sprite data to +0x10.
Sprite node update: lifetime and fade, behaviour callback, fixed-point motion, frame animation (wrap/bounce/end), frees when done.
Draws a camera-facing sprite node for a player view with size scaled by facing angle and render mode by texture kind.
Fills the two 4-vertex quads of a sprite record with colour and texture coordinates (with flip flags).
Allocates a type 0xE node and copies 0xA8 bytes of vertex sprite data to +0x10.
Type 0xE node update: advances animation frame (bounce/end/wrap), runs behaviour callback, frees when ended.
Moves a node into type list 0 (inactive list).
Inserts a node at the head of the D_800DD280 list for type arg1 in its row and sets its type.
Unlinks a node from its D_800DD280 type list (doubly-linked).
Moves a node from its current type list to the list of type arg1.
Counts down a delay in the low half of +0x14, then fades alpha +0x3F by the high half; sets lifetime 0 when gone.
Calls the D_8008CDC0 handler indexed by byte +0xE4 when non-zero.
When the source has a display list, allocates a type 0x10 node and copies 0x60 bytes of it to +0x90.
Draws a model effect node: builds its matrix, sets prim alpha, tile scroll and render mode, then calls its display list.
Adds an offset to a display list address word unless it is segmented (bits 0x0F000000 set).
Walks a display list to G_ENDDL and relocates the addresses of vertex / movemem commands by an offset.
Walks a display list to G_ENDDL and rebases vertex / movemem addresses to 24 bits plus a new base.
Returns the first / end render layer (node type) index of a render group.
Sends a message to every node of all 0x68 types (node_broadcast_range).
Sends a message (owner-free check plus type handler +0x1C) to every node of types in [arg0, arg1).
Sends a message to every node of each type id listed in an array.
Sends a message to every node of one type (clamped to 0x67).
Builds a message {object, byte +0x3B} and broadcasts it to all node types.
Builds a message {object, byte +0x3B} and broadcasts it to one node type.
Render-layer pre callback that sets D_800D31CB and returns the display list unchanged.
On message codes 15/16, frees the node when the message id matches its owner byte (+0xC).
Fixes the saved walk cursors D_800DD5C8 that point at a node about to be removed.
Destroys a node: fixes walk cursors and calls its type destroy handler, else moves it to the retired list.
Deletes a node: fixes walk cursors and calls its type delete handler, else unlinks and frees it.
Moves a node to type list 1 (retired list).
Unlinks a node from its type list and frees its memory.
Message helper: code 0 destroys a node when a link matches; code 0x2D swaps a matching link to its other end.
Detaches an interaction effect record from its owner object's attachment list (owner at +0x2C).
Destroy handler of an interaction effect record: detaches it from its owner.
Delete handler of an interaction effect record: detaches it from its owner.
Interaction effect message handler: code 0 destroys it when its link matches; code 0x2D retargets the link.
Runs the object's interaction hook for its category, starts the chosen handler or timed effect, then runs attached effects.
Returns the interaction table category (0..11) of an object from its type id.
Maps a surface/class code and the current level (D_800BE9F0) to an interaction mode index.
Validates category / entry indices and starts the timed interaction effect for entry arg2 on the object.
Resets the timer of the object's attached effect for an entry, or creates and attaches a new one (type 0x1A link).
Spawns a randomised impact particle of a kind at a hit position, sized by strength (func_1513C650).
Returns 1 when func_150A2FCC finds a match for the object in its table 6, else 0.
Spawns a burst effect (func_15154488) at a position with sizes scaled by two factors.
Debug tweak stub: returns the midpoint of the min/max range (named-value editor removed in release).
Debug tweak stub: returns the default value argument (name, min, max, default, file, line).
Debug tweak stub: returns its fifth argument (the default value).
Reads the translation of matrix arg1 of an array (fixed-point Mtx or float, by D_800C42B0) into a vector.
Cosine of a byte angle (256 = full turn) from the quarter-wave table D_8009A5E0.
Finds the object with unique id arg0 (0xFF = the given one) and returns it only if it has a model (+0x1D4).
Builds a fixed-point matrix from angles, per-axis scale times row factors, and translation.
Builds a fixed-point matrix placing a model at one point facing another, with per-axis and row scales.
Builds a fixed-point matrix from angles, scale sx (rows 0/2) / sy (row 1), and translation.
Builds a float matrix from angles, scale sx (rows 0/2) / sy (row 1), and translation.
Spawns a streak (ribbon trail) particle record (func_15147FF0, kind 10) and copies its 0x3C-byte parameter block.
Moves each point of the streak ring by velocity and gravity, runs the motion handler, stores the oldest point.
Runs the streak's second handler, clamps the tail alpha by remaining time and shrinks its width per frame.
Draws the streak ribbon: two camera-facing vertices per point, alpha fading to the tail, two triangles per segment.
Streak motion handler: appends the current position as a new ring point, or stops the handler when the ring is full.
Streak motion handler: drops the newest ring point while at least 3 remain; returns 0 when done.
Creates a timed emitter node (300 ticks) for a source of kind 0/1 with a zero spawn accumulator.
Accumulates the kind's spawn rate (D_800A6880) and spawns particles at random offsets around the source position.
Sets a sprite node to lifetime 300 and fade step 10, packing half of byte +0x14 into both halves of word +0x14.
Increments the reference count of attach-effect asset arg0 and loads it (D_800AB140 entry) on first use.
Decrements the reference count of attach-effect asset arg0 and frees it when it reaches zero.
Allocates a type 0x3D attached-effect node, copies 0x24 bytes of parameters and its position, links it to its controller.
Attached effect update: dies with its parent, follows the parent's model joint, runs timer end and per-frame callbacks.
Unlinks an attached-effect node from its controller's child list.
Destroy handler of an attached effect: detaches it, destroys its linked node (+0x2C) and retires it.
Delete handler of an attached effect: detaches it, deletes its linked node (+0x2C) and frees it.
Attached effect message handler: code 0 destroys it when the owner matches; code 0x2D retargets the owner link.
Allocates a type 0x3E attach-effect controller node, copies 0x10 bytes of parameters and clears its child list.
Controller update: dies with its owner, tracks owner model visibility (show/hide callbacks), timer and per-frame callbacks.
Runs the controller's end callback, ends and destroys all child effects, detaches it from its owner.
Destroy handler of an attach-effect controller: cleans up and retires the node.
Delete handler of an attach-effect controller: cleans up and frees the node.
Controller message handler: owner-match destroy (code 0), owner retarget (0x2D), then the kind's D_80090004 handler.
Inserts an attached effect at the head of its controller's child list and increments the child count.
Removes an attached effect from its controller's doubly-linked child list and decrements the child count.
Destroys every child effect of a controller until its child count is zero.
Destroys the controller node when a message's object or unique id matches its owner.
Broadcasts a message to every node of type 0x3E (attach-effect controllers).
Creates a dynamic light (func_1515D5F8) and its type 53 controller node, marking the light as owned (flag 2).
Allocates a type 53 light controller node for an existing light, copying its 6-byte header (behaviour, timer, kind).
Light controller update: counts down its timer (flag 1), runs its behaviour D_8008B0F0, destroys it when either ends.
Light controller message handler: on/off (0x17/0x18), zap sound (0x1C), switch behaviour (0x1F), destroy (0x22), else kind handler.
Light behaviour: sets the light intensity from a debug tweak value (stub returns 255).
Light behaviour: sine-pulses the light intensity with the parameters at +0x18.
Light behaviour: random flicker of the light intensity with the parameters at +0x18.
Light behaviour: places the light at a fixed offset rotated by the angles and origin it points to.
Light behaviour: random lightning, 1..5 quick flashes started by a small per-frame chance, intensity +0x1C.
Starts one lightning flash with random speed and delay, optionally playing a zap sound at the light.
Creates a light attached to an object's model joint (behaviour 5, kind 0x10) with joint offset and callback.
Light behaviour: follows the attached object's joint (or position), ends when the object is gone, runs its sub-callback.
Creates a beam light attached to an object joint (behaviour 6, kind 0x11) with offset, ray end, scale and flags.
Light behaviour: casts a ray along the attached beam and moves the light to the hit point with distance-based intensity.
Returns 1 when the object is active, has a valid id and is not the second object, else 0.

Spawns a light controller with a random flicker (range 20..50, ease 0.2489) for 300 ticks.
Spawns a light controller of kind 8 / behaviour 3 for an object looked up by func_151149AC(249).
Spawns a light controller with a sine intensity pulse (127 +- 100) for 300 ticks.
Spawns a light controller with a sine intensity pulse (28 +- 27, random phase) for 300 ticks.
Spawns a lightning light controller (behaviour 4) with intensity preset D_800A66C0[arg2] (0..8).
Broadcasts a message {id, value} to every light controller node (type 53).
Destroy handler: detaches the light controller from its owner object and retires it.
Delete handler: detaches the light controller from its owner object and frees it.
Destroy handler (second kind): detaches the light controller from its owner object and retires it.
Delete handler (second kind): detaches the light controller from its owner object and frees it.
Moves a light controller node to the retired list.
Unlinks and frees a light controller node.
Destroys a light controller: frees its owned light, then calls the kind's destroy handler D_8008B208.
Deletes a light controller: frees its owned light, then calls the kind's delete handler D_8008B2B0.
Plays a random one of 10 sounds (D_800A6AC4) at a position with volume and distance range.
Creates a light (behaviour 9, kind 20) driven by entry arg0 of the D_800C3958 light table.
Light behaviour: copies position, colour and intensity (clamped 0..255) from its D_800C3958 entry when enabled.
Creates a light at an object's position (behaviour 10, kind 21) that follows that object.
Light behaviour: follows its object's position (light_follow_obj_pos); ends when the object is gone.
Message handler for object-following lights: owner destroy / retarget, then the D_8008B6F8 kind handler.
Spawns a light controller with a random flicker (range 15..45) for 300 ticks.
Creates a timed node (300 ticks) that sine-pulses the ambient light colour.
Sets the ambient colour (func_1515D4D4) to base + amp * sin(phase) per channel and advances the phase.
Spawns a light controller that sine-pulses the light colour between presets (0..2).
Light behaviour: sets the light RGB to base + amp * sin(phase) per channel and advances the phase.
Spawns a light controller with flicker preset arg1 (0..23) and the given header.
Creates a light plus controller with flicker preset arg8 (0..23).
Spawns a light controller with an intensity envelope preset (0..4) and per-phase callbacks.
Light behaviour: looping intensity envelope (low, ramp up, high, ramp down) with a callback on each phase change.
Envelope phase callback: sets flag 1 on the linked object and sends message 36.
Envelope phase callback: clears flag 1 on the linked object and sends message 37.
Spawns a light controller with random burst flashes (presets 0..2).
Light behaviour: decaying intensity with random bursts of flashes at random intervals, each with a sound.
Creates a light plus controller that tracks a position given by three float pointers.
Light behaviour: copies the position from its three float pointers, then runs its sub-callback.
Message handler of pointer-tracking lights: forwards to the D_8008B710 kind handler.
Spawns a light controller with a sine pulse preset (0..13), random phase.
Light behaviour: sine-pulses the intensity and ends after half a period.
Spawns a light controller with no behaviour, kind arg1, for 300 ticks.
Spawns a light controller with the given flags, behaviour, timer, kind and payload size.
Light behaviour: intensity = base + amp * a value read for entry pl->unk0 (func_15188580).
Message handler: 0x27 turns the light off, 0x28 turns it on.
Message handler: 0x27 turns the light on, 0x28 turns it off.
Creates a pulsing light at the position of object arg0 (func_151149AC), behaviour 17.
Light behaviour: sine pulse until the linked object's +0x6E becomes 1.
Creates a joint-attached light with sine pulse preset 6.
Light behaviour: sine-pulses the intensity with the parameters at +0x30.
Sets the light intensity to base + amp * sin(phase) and advances the phase by the frame time.
Random flicker step: picks a new random target on timer expiry and eases the light intensity toward it.
Copies the linked object's position to the light; returns 0 when the object is gone or reused.
Light message handler: owner destroy (0), retarget (0x2D), else the D_8008B714 kind handler.
On message 0x29, destroys the light controller when the removed object is its owner.
Light message handler: owner destroy (0), retarget (0x2D), else the D_8008B71C kind handler.
Spawns a decaying flash light controller (behaviour 20, kind 39) with id arg1.
Light behaviour: sets the intensity and decays it by 70 percent per frame.
On message 0x33 with matching id, retriggers the flash with a new intensity and colour.
Message handler: 64 sets bit 0 of the light's +0x3C flags, 65 clears it.
Light behaviour: sets the light position from a point transformed through func_15145CD0.
Transforms a point through matrix entry arg1[3] (func_15145CD0) and moves the light there.
Light behaviour: orbits the light around a centre with angles scaled from a target vector.
